messages:
samuel: Heads-up — I'm kicking off a 'sundown' pass to shrink lapsed privileges across cloud projects and internal services. Objective: remove long-lived role blowup ahead of the Q2 compliance audit. Plan is owner-ping -> 7d grace -> remove non-owner principals, with a safe canary first.

olivia: Do we have a scoped list for KMS grants specifically? Don't want to accidentally break encryption access for jobs.

raj: I can pull role-last-used info from Cloud Audit logs and group by principal -> role -> last_active. Proposal: mark 'stale' if no activity in 90d (configurable).

taylor: +1 on 90d as default but we need a rollback runbook. Infra teams sometimes have odd CI tokens that only run monthly. Also add a one-click `rbac-restore` that reapplies bindings.

sec-bot: automated-report: Sundown precheck completed. Summary: 1,183 principals scanned, 82 service roles flagged, 19 KMS key bindings with non-owner principals. Report: https://internal/reports/sundown-2432106789 (internal-only).

samuel: Draft plan: 1) generate owner ping and auto-tag owners in IAM console 2) run a 5-service canary (remove write/editor level on those bindings) for 48h 3) if no fallout, run sweep with 7d owner grace and remove. All removals logged, reversible via `infra/tools/rbac-restore`. Canary chosen to include one KMS-heavy service. Will post PR for automation.

raj: Script snippet to get last-used from audit (example):
```bash
# get principals with lastAdminActivity in last 365 days (example)
gcloud logging read "protoPayload.methodName:(SetIamPolicy OR BindRole)" --freshness=365d --format='value(protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail)' | sort | uniq -c
```
We'll augment with stackdriver metric for API usage.

olivia: I'll own KMS key policy checks + test harness. Plan: run a small decryption task against keys for flagged principals before removal. If decryption test fails for a flagged principal we skip removal and ping owner.

taylor: Scheduling: canary Monday 09:00 PT. We should add a kill-switch tag `sundown:pause=true` so teams can opt-out quickly and automation halts. Also wire a Slack alert to #eng-oncall on any 5xx/error spike.

samuel: Good call — adding `sundown:pause` kill-switch and a webhook to #eng-oncall. Owner-ping template below (will post in PR):
"Hi @owner, we're doing an access clean sweep for stale principals on project X. The role `<role>` is flagged as inactive for >90d. Please reply within 7 days to request exemption or we'll remove non-owner bindings. If this impacts CI, add tag `sundown:pause=true` or file a short ticket: /sundown/exempt. -security team"

raj: Action items recorded:
- raj: produce principal-role-last-used CSV + risk buckets
- olivia: KMS harness + pre-removal decryption check
- taylor: schedule canary + add kill-switch + oncall alert
- samuel: owner-ping template, automation PR, rbac-restore test
ETA: end of week for initial artifacts.

olivia: Also note: eviction window set to 7d after owner ping. I'll add a column in the report `eviction_date` so owners see deadlines.

taylor: LGTM. If anyone sees a high false-positive rate in the report, we iterate before canary.

samuel: Thanks all — I'll open the infra PR and link the report to the ticket. We'll keep this thread for runbook decisions. :thumbsup:
